what_is_it.explanation: Elephant Goldfish Model (EGM) is an open-source plugin for AI assistants that aids in software design and review. It splits tasks between an 'Elephant' persona that holds project context to draft specifications, and 'Goldfish' reviewers that evaluate the draft without prior conversational bias to expose blind spots and unstated assumptions.
what_is_it.one_line: An open-source plugin for designing and reviewing software with AI agents.
